cupt_options.description: List of top-level cupt:: option assignments (e.g., cupt::resolver::keep-recommends). Each item must contain 'name' and optionally 'value'. 'comment' is used for human-readable description in config comments only and is not emitted in config output. Values are emitted as bare booleans or strings per cupt.conf(5) syntax. For non-boolean values, 'value' may be a string like '"value"'.

limit_releases_by_archive.description: List of archive names (e.g., 'stable', 'testing') to include/exclude. Use with cupt::cache::limit-releases::by-archive and cupt::cache::limit-releases::by-archive::type set appropriately.

limit_releases_by_archive_type.description: Type for archive limiting (include or exclude). Corresponds to cupt::cache::limit-releases::by-archive::type.

limit_releases_by_codename.description: List of codenames (e.g., 'bullseye', 'focal') to include/exclude. Use with cupt::cache::limit-releases::by-codename and cupt::cache::limit-releases::by-codename::type set appropriately.

limit_releases_by_codename_type.description: Type for codename limiting (include or exclude). Corresponds to cupt::cache::limit-releases::by-codename::type.

resolver_options.description: Resolver-specific options (e.g., cupt::resolver::type, cupt::resolver::keep-recommends, cupt::resolver::max-solution-count). Each item must contain 'name' and optionally 'value'. For numeric options, 'value' is a bare integer (e.g., 32000). For boolean options, 'value' may be omitted (defaults to true). Comments describe the setting.

apt_options.description: APT-level options (e.g., apt::install-recommends, apt::cache::allversions, apt::cache::recursedepends, apt::cache::important, apt::cache::namesonly). Each item must contain 'name' and optionally 'value'.

console_actions_preview.description: Console preview settings that control actions-preview output (e.g., cupt::console::actions-preview::show-archives, show-codenames, show-reasons, show-size-changes, show-components, show-versions, show-vendors, show-not-preferred). Each item must contain 'name' and optionally 'value' (typically omitted for booleans).
